text: Security is a vital part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor login, helps confirm that users are who they claim to be. Developers must also check all input carefully to stop malicious code from entering the system. Common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting can cause serious damage if these protections are missing. By focusing on these basic rules, developers can build safer websites and protect both users and their data.
